title: fix(ui,platform-objects): invitation screens — labelled statuses, role help, resend as a confirmation, dialog focus and email check
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKKC66puRHhWEAxZHdQjYYQ)_

Part of #27521
Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/app-shell` exports `InvitationLinkHint` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` exports `useInitialFieldFocus`; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none (platform object metadata only, no authorable key: `sys_invitation.status` options gain display labels, with `rejected` read as "Declined"; the role param of the four `invite_user` actions, `sys_member.add_member` and `sys_member.update_member_role` gains one shared `helpText`; `sys_invitation.resend_invitation` gains a `description` and carries its email and role over from the row; `sys_member.update_member_role` gains a `description` naming the member; the `expired` invitations list projects `role`)

This PR lands rows 7, 8, 9, 10 (the invite half), 11 and 23 of the 18.3.0 RC walkthrough, minus two pieces that need a decision or a spec member (see Acceptance notes). It keeps the card open.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:邀请相关页面的六处体验问题。状态显示成标签(待接受、已接受、已拒绝…),所有分配组织角色的选择框都逐行解释每个角色,「更改角色」点名被改的成员;「重新发送」改成一句确认(写明发给谁、到期重新计算),不再弹可编辑表单;邀请时邮箱格式错误直接标在输入框下,不再横幅加 toast 报两遍;登录页提示受邀者打开邀请链接;接受邀请后显示「已加入 X 组织,角色为 Y」并有「继续」;所有操作弹窗打开时聚焦第一个输入框,关闭后焦点回到打开它的按钮。
- **为什么改**:18.3.0 RC 走查(#27521)在这些页面记下的问题:原始小写状态值、角色无解释、重发像是在改邀请、错误报两遍且字段不标红、受邀者不知道该点链接、加入后没有确认、键盘用户关弹窗后焦点丢到页面顶端。
- **风险与回滚**:参数弹窗新增的客户端格式校验对所有动作生效,email/url 类型参数填了表单本就拒绝的值时,现在提交前就被拦下;焦点归还在 document 上挂了两个捕获阶段监听(只记录最后一次点击/按键的控件)。无数据迁移,回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogReturnFocus.ts`(焦点归还,尤其等待被禁用按钮恢复的那段);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`(提交时先查必填再查格式);`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-invitation.object.ts`(重发改为带入行上的 email/role)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogFocus-27521.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.invitationScreens-27521.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、18 个用例全过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Platform objects (`@objectstack/platform-objects`)**

- Row 7: `sys_invitation.status` options carry labels (Pending, Accepted, Declined, Expired, Canceled), so list cells read the label instead of the raw value. The `expired` list view also projects `role`, as the other views do.
- Row 8: one help text, `MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_PARAM_HELP` in the new `identity/membership-role-help.ts`, explains each built-in membership role on its own line. It is built from `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_OPTIONS`, so a role and its label cannot drift. All six role pickers that grant an organization role use it: the four `invite_user` actions (on `sys_invitation`, `sys_member`, `sys_user`, `sys_organization`), `add_member` and `update_member_role`. `update_member_role` gains a description that names the member, with a fallback for a row that does not expand the user.
- Row 9: `resend_invitation` becomes a confirmation. Its description names the invitee and says the expiry starts over, and its email and role params carry over from the row, so the dialog shows no editable inputs.
- Translations: the four generated bundles are regenerated, and the zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES leaves are translated by hand.

**Shared action dialogs (`@object-ui/app-shell`)**

The change moves three shared dialogs that every declared action uses: `ActionParamDialog`, `ActionConfirmDialog` and `ActionResultDialog`. `useConsoleActionRuntime` is unchanged.

- Row 10: `ActionParamDialog` checks an `email` or `url` param against the same format rule the object form uses (`buildValidationRules` from `@object-ui/fields`) before anything runs. A malformed value is marked on its field (message under it, `aria-invalid`), and the run never starts, so the old banner plus toast cannot appear. An empty required field still reads "X is required". Carried-over values and empty optional values are not judged.
- Row 8: help text under a param keeps its line breaks (`whitespace-pre-line`), so the role help reads one role per line.
- Row 23, opening: the param dialog opens on its first editable field instead of the footer's Cancel. It reuses the object form's `useInitialFieldFocus`, now exported from `@object-ui/plugin-form`. A dialog of carried-over values only opens on itself.
- Row 23, closing: the new `actionDialogReturnFocus.ts` gives all three dialogs `useActionDialogReturnFocus`. When a dialog closes, focus goes back to the control that opened it. This covers three openers that defeated Radix's default:
  - An action button that is disabled while its action runs. Chrome blurs it before the dialog opens, so the opener is read from the last pointer or key activation. Focus waits for the button to be enabled again, unless the user moves focus elsewhere first.
  - A row menu item, whose menu is gone by then. The opener is the menu's trigger.
  - A param dialog that hands over to a result dialog. The result dialog returns to the first opener.

  With no opener (focus on `body` and no recent activation), Radix's default stays.

**Invitation pages (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`)**

- Row 9 (workspace page): the Invitations page's cancel dialog dismisses with "Keep invitation".
- Row 11: the sign-in page shows "Have an invitation? Open the link in the invitation email to accept it." where sign-up is by invitation only. `InvitationLinkHint` lives with the other invitation-arrival pieces and is rendered by both sign-in pages, the app-shell default and the console's own. After accepting, the accept page shows "Invitation accepted", "Welcome to ORG. You joined as ROLE." and a focused Continue button that enters the organization, instead of a toast and an immediate redirect.
- i18n: four new keys, in all ten packs.

## Tests

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/invitation-screens-copy.test.ts` (new) pins:
  - the status labels, and that the en bundle carries them;
  - that the help has one line per `BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_OPTIONS` label, and that all six pickers carry it;
  - the Change Role description and its fallback;
  - the resend description and its carried-over params, and that every invitations list projects email and role;
  - that the translated leaves keep their placeholders and one help line per role.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.invitationScreens-27521.test.tsx` (new, 10 cases), under a real English `I18nProvider`:
  - a malformed email is marked and nothing runs, with no refusal banner;
  - the mark clears on the next keystroke;
  - required wins over format;
  - a url is held to the url rule, and the control case is a text param;
  - `paramFormatErrorKey` skips carried-over and empty values;
  - help line breaks are kept;
  - the Change Role description is interpolated by a real `ActionRunner` from a list row.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/actionDialogFocus-27521.test.tsx` (new, 8 cases):
  - the dialog opens on the first field, and a carry-over-only dialog on itself;
  - Escape returns focus to a disabled action button, both when it kept focus and when the browser blurred it;
  - a user who moved focus keeps it;
  - a row menu's Delete confirm returns to the menu trigger (the non-invitation pin);
  - a param dialog that hands over to a result dialog returns to the first opener;
  - control: with no opener, Radix's default stays.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/invitation-screens-27521.test.ts` (new): all ten packs carry the four keys, translated, with the English placeholders.
- Cases added to existing suites: the sign-in hint in both posture suites (`defaultPagesFollowPosture-11705`, `signUpFollowsPosture-11691`), "Keep invitation" in `org-i18n-holdouts-4474`, and the joined state plus Continue in `AcceptInvitationRoute` (its toast assertion is replaced).

## Acceptance notes

| Row | Producer | Fix | Test | Live-checked |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 7 | `sys_invitation.status` options had no labels | Labels; `rejected` reads "Declined" | `invitation-screens-copy.test.ts` | y |
| 8 | Each role picker had its own one-line help; `update_member_role` had no description | One shared help, one line per role, on six pickers; `whitespace-pre-line`; Change Role names the member | `invitation-screens-copy.test.ts`, `ActionParamDialog.invitationScreens-27521.test.tsx` | y |
| 9 | `resend_invitation` declared editable params; the workspace cancel dialog used a generic Cancel | Resend is a confirmation with carried-over params; "Keep invitation" | `invitation-screens-copy.test.ts`, `org-i18n-holdouts-4474.test.tsx` | y |
| 10 (invite) | `ActionParamDialog` checked only required, so the server's refusal showed twice | Client-side format check marked on the field, before the run | `ActionParamDialog.invitationScreens-27521.test.tsx` | y |
| 11 | No hint on the plain sign-in page; accepting toasted and redirected | `InvitationLinkHint` on both sign-in pages; a joined state with Continue | posture suites, `AcceptInvitationRoute.test.tsx`, `invitation-screens-27521.test.ts` | y |
| 23 | The dialogs had no initial focus target and no return target | First field on open; return to the opener on close | `actionDialogFocus-27521.test.tsx` | y |

What is left on the card, so this PR says `Part of`:

- **Row 9, admin page.** The declared Cancel Invitation confirm still reads "Cancel" and "Cancel Invitation". Its dismiss label needs a spec member on the action's confirm, which this card does not own.
- **Row 11, pre-fill.** Pre-filling the invited email on the registration form is a `needs_decision` against ADR-0138.
- **Row 10, Create User.** The "Either email or phoneNumber is required" message and the missing asterisks belong to the Create User half, which this card does not own. Create User's dialog does get the row 23 focus fix, because the dialogs are shared.

Live check (private stack, `invite_only` posture, Chrome):

- **Invite User:** the dialog opens on Email. A malformed email shows "Please enter a valid email address" under the field, with `aria-invalid=true` and no toast. The role help reads one role per line. Both Escape and a successful invite return focus to Invite User.
- **Invitations list:** the status cells read "Pending".
- **Resend:** the dialog reads "Resend the invitation to ada@example.com? Its expiry date starts over." and has no editable inputs. Escape returns focus to the row's "Open menu".
- **Admin Cancel Invitation:** the dismiss label is unchanged (remainder), and focus returns to the trigger.
- **Sign-in:** the plain sign-in page shows the hint.
- **Accepting:** an invitee signs up and accepts, then reads "Invitation accepted / Welcome to Default Organization. You joined as Member." with focus on Continue, which lands on the root.
- **Create User:** the dialog opens on Email, and Escape returns focus to Create User.
- **Change Role** (Members related list on the organization page): reads "Choose the new organization role for Ada Lovelace." with the role help. It opens on the role picker, and Escape returns focus to "Row actions".
